title: The Hyperfine Ghost
author: Dentatus Series 300
hypothesis: The S_A and S_C ghost channels can be coupled via a declared J_AC matrix to produce a precession-angle observable Omega_AC that measures inter-channel phase drift. Omega_AC is P_yz-invariant and provides a deterministic lag selection rule for multi-lag TE (EXP-310 upgrade path).
J_AC_note: 4x4 identity matrix. J_AC @ S_A[0:4] = S_A[0:4] (direct coupling, no rotation).
W_max_note: Maximum lag window for tau_opt derivation.
Omega_AC_formula: Omega_AC = arccos(clip( (J_AC @ S_A[0:4]) . S_C / (norm(J_AC @ S_A[0:4]) * norm(S_C) + eps), -1, 1 ))
Omega_AC_note: Misalignment angle between J_AC-projected S_A and S_C in radians [0, pi]. Omega_AC = 0: channels aligned (same direction in dual space). Omega_AC = pi: channels anti-aligned. Omega_AC = pi/2: orthogonal (maximum information content).
tau_opt_note: Deterministic lag selection from precession angle. Large Omega_AC (misaligned channels) -> longer lag window. Replaces brute-force lag scan from EXP-310.
ghost_history_note: Extends EXP-311/312/313 ghost_history with Omega_AC and tau_opt at each partition step.
P_yz_Omega_AC_proof: S_A[0:4] and S_C are norms-only observables (both P_yz-invariant from EXP-313). J_AC = identity (no spatial axes). cos(Omega_AC) = (S_A[0:4] . S_C) / (norm(S_A[0:4]) * norm(S_C)). Under P_yz: S_A[0:4] and S_C are unchanged (Sector A and C norms are P_yz-invariant). Therefore cos(Omega_AC) is P_yz-invariant => Omega_AC_fwd == Omega_AC_mir. QED
dual_space_constraint: J_AC coupling is DUAL SPACE ONLY: modifies only the ghost_history observable. Does NOT modify Z_t, stalk values, or primary operator pipeline. Dual arithmetic separation maintained.
fork_a_assertions: ghost_history contains (S_A_norm, S_C_norm, Omega_AC, tau_opt) at each step
